personality_one_liner: A premium, authoritative marketplace where dark navy depth meets striking gold accents for absolute trust and professionalism.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for a premium feel. Do not cramp elements. Sticky CTAs must have scroll clearance.

do's: Use on sticky headers, bottom tab bar, featured provider cards overlays, modal scrims.
dont's: Do not use on body text regions, form fields, or every single list row.

screens.name: Onboarding & Role Selection
screens.purpose: Introduce the platform and branch users to either Client or Provider.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Large typography header. Two massive pill-shaped Glass cards for 'I am a Client' and 'I am a Provider'.

screens.name: Client_Home

states.loading: Skeletons for category grid and provider cards.

screens.layout: Top sticky header with location. Search bar below it. A promo banner (glass over abstract navy/gold image). A horizontal scroll row for Categories using tinted icon containers. A 'Featured Providers' section with horizontally scrolling cards showing provider photo, name, rating, and rate. A sticky chip row for quick filters under the search bar.

screens.name: Provider_Profile
screens.purpose: View provider details and initiate booking.
screens.layout: Hero image banner with provider avatar intersecting the bottom edge. Name and 'Verified' gold badge. Star rating and reviews count. Bio paragraph. List of services offered (prices). Sticky primary CTA 'Request Booking' anchored at the bottom with a glass background.

screens.name: Booking_Flow
screens.layout: Clean mobile-first layout. Calendar date picker. Horizontally scrollable time-slot chips. Multi-line text input for task description. Fixed bottom CTA to confirm.

screens.name: Provider_Dashboard
screens.purpose: Manage earnings, bookings, and subscription status.
screens.layout: Top stat blocks (earnings, completed tasks). A prominent banner for Subscription Status ('3 months free trial active' or '1000 DZD due'). List of recent bookings with Status tags.

onboarding_hero.alt: Abstract navy and gold fluid background

empty_state.alt: Abstract subtle wave for empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere STRICTLY to the Dark Navy and Gold palette. The brief explicitly authorized Navy.
Use Glassmorphism (expo-blur) on the bottom tab bar, sticky bottom CTAs, and featured provider cards over background images to create a premium 'Luxe' feel.
For the Provider Dashboard, prominently display the Subscription banner. Show the '3 months free trial' vs '1000 DZD' clearly.
Ensure the booking flow uses horizontally scrollable time chips and clear date pickers as per modern marketplace conventions (Mobbin insights).
Add gradient scrims behind text that overlays images, especially in the onboarding hero and provider profile covers.
Implement JWT Auth mock flow for login.
Avoid typical Material purple/blue. Stick entirely to the #0B1120 base and #D4AF37 accents.
